$comment: Connect service -> binary ownership map (docs/plans/connect-rpc/03, D5). The single checked-in source both the edge rules and scripts/checks/repo_checks.py connect-edge-routing read. Every Connect service declared under proto/codewire/** or proto/coordinator/** must appear in exactly one of 'owners', 'pending', or 'unrouted'. Owner values: 'orchestration' (reached through the /codewire. fallback unless named in 'explicit'; must never appear in a billing-targeted rule), 'billing' (needs an explicit billing-targeted rule in all six edge files; must never appear in an orchestration-targeted rule), 'coordinator' (needs an explicit :8090/codewire-coordinator rule plus h2c/GRPC/3600 shape in all six files), 'testing' (the D8 probe: never routed in Caddyfiles/base, explicit proof rules in the kind/local manifests only). 'explicit' records orchestration-owned services whose per-Service matcher is a workstream requirement. 'pending' lists services whose proto has merged but whose serving/edge wiring has not. 'unrouted' is the closed cluster-local listener exception: its record fixes binary, listener, and Service port and is rejected if it gains a public edge matcher or public-listener mount.
